name: krypto-terminal
description: A free, local-first Solana memecoin trading terminal. Discover, analyse and trade — with a live launch scanner and automation engine built in. Part of the Krypt free tools suite.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && node scripts/gen-fee-integrity.mjs && node scripts/gen-presence-integrity.mjs && node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs && vite build && node scripts/obfuscate-main.mjs && node scripts/harden-bytecode.mjs
